description: Create a SHIP-hosted site for a project and hold its address, https://<slug>.<sites domain>. The kind of the site comes from the template. Each project can hold one site, and the plan of the organization sets how many sites it can hold. A refused slug or a full plan comes back with the reason. This tool calls the SHIP API, documented at https://letsship.ai/docs/api. Requires the config:write capability.

projectId.description: Project id the site belongs to

slug.description: The address: 3 to 40 of a-z, 0-9 and single hyphens, e.g. 'acme-blog'

templateId.description: A template id from list_site_templates, e.g. 'blog'

name: create_site
title: Create a site
